newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers steady, calm after busy midweek.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers steady, calm after busy midweek.

text.p: European fuel oil bunker prices were steady on Friday, while diesel and gas oil still had to catch up with cargo and barge strength from earlier in the week, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst traded at around $115 fob for both late September and early October loadings.

After healthy trade on Wednesday and Thursday, bunker market activity died out, with about 10,000 tonnes of business in the ARA area. Dealers said most essential short-covering was completed until the middle of next week.
Hamburg prices were also steady at around $123 fob.
Dealers said the premium of around $8 above Rotterdam quotations was the result of high imported cargo prices.
Mediterranean prices were also steady. As in ARA, activity was thin after midweek business. Dealers said Spanish and French ports had picked up much of the trade.
"We have no complaints about this week, but today has been very quiet," a French supplier said.
Durban fuel oil prices remained firm, although an expected easing of supply problems in October left forward prices $10 lower than prompt.
